text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, I went to check on Gentildonna's 
lesson...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (BAMMM!!)
choice_data_list:
(!? Was that the sound of feet kicking off 
the floor...?)

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. It seems the floor gave way 
just a little.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text: ...Amazing...! Such powerful leaps...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Ms. Gentile! How did you do that jump just 
now?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: ? I haven't done anything special.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Channel power into your legs and kick off 
the ground— that's all there is to it.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
That's all...? Um, is there anything else 
you keep in mind?

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I've been thinking about the performance 
for my new song! The motif is the swans of 
Tomakomai!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
"A swan's elegance is lovely, but the 
power with which it spreads its wings to 
soar across the open sky is just as 
captivating! Please, keep that in mind!"

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Huh, how ambitious. I don't mind that 
attitude at all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Still, all I did was jump. How should I 
answer them?
choice_data_list: How about showing that jump one more time?

How about teaching you how to carry 
yourself with elegance, or something?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Shall we move somewhere 
else, then?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: It is a bit cramped here, after all.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Now then, Tarumae-san. Are you watching 
closely?

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Hmph!!!!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
! That high...!? It's truly like a swan 
taking flight...!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
W-What an amazing jump! And, I finally 
understand!

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Such a stable core! Her leap without any 
axis wobble is just like a swan powerfully 
taking flight from a lake...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
Heh. Looks like you gained something from 
it.

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
In that case, grasp it from here. The 
performance you truly envision.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
Please! That jump just now was so 
gorgeous, right down to your 
fingertips...!

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text:
True. There are many ways to pick up 
proper conduct, but if it's stage 
presence—

text_block_list.name: Gentildonna
text_block_list.text: Slow, slow, quick, quick.

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
...Ugh! Every single movement feels so 
overwhelmingly heavy...

text_block_list.name: Hokko Tarumae
text_block_list.text:
I-I have to master it! A posture where my 
muscles envelop me from my toes to my 
fingertips...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Through ballroom dance, Gentildonna 
drilled down the fundamentals of... 
"beautiful" comportment.
